title: Live fixed-weight neural closed loop on the controlled game

steps_per_update_rule.drift_policy: absolute game time; rounding error is bounded at half a neural step and does not accumulate

sign_policy.interpretation: excitatory and inhibitory are modelling priors applied to the presynaptic neuron; they are not established postsynaptic effects at every target

weight_policy.weight_source: integer synapse count (`count`); `norm` is never used
weight_policy.interpretation: weights are structural synapse counts raised to a monotone transform and scaled to pA; they are not conductances

provenance.node_order: ascending banc_888_id, identical to graph root_ids
provenance.unknown_edges: excluded from propagation; they contribute zero current

stepper.reset_policy: once per episode; the network is never restarted between game updates

mapping.classification: experimental input population selected from published BANC annotation columns; the feature assignment is a hypothesis, not a verified sensory pathway

train_lane.statement: Game lanes are assigned to anatomical sides of the visual-projection pool; the center lane uses the side-unassigned remainder. There is no measured receptive-field or lane map in the BANC annotation.

obstacle_lane.statement: The same side convention as H4H4-B, applied to obstacle events; the center group is a small side-unassigned pool.

train_present.statement: Visual-projection output cells stand in for the presence of a train. The annotation supports the cell class, not this feature assignment.

train_distance.statement: Achromatic optic-lobe intrinsic cells stand in for a distance/looming proxy. Achromatic tuning is annotated; looming selectivity is not.

obstacle_present.statement: Photoreceptors stand in for obstacle presence. The annotation supports the receptor class, not the game feature.

obstacle_distance.statement: The same achromatic intrinsic pool as H4H4-C, drawn disjointly, stands in for obstacle distance.

obstacle_type.statement: Obstacle type is encoded as two arbitrary halves of the photoreceptor pool; the annotation does not define obstacle classes.

limitations: Annotation-defined populations, not measured sensory anatomy or physiology.
The feature assignment is a hypothesis; a visual annotation is not evidence of a direct visual pathway to motor control.
No held per-frame state exists for the archived events; drive is carried by discrete event pulses only.
No FAFB root ID is transferred; FAFB and BANC identities are never merged.

policy.semantics: activation * current_pa is added to the mapped neurons on every neural step; the drive never overwrites other input
policy.update_rule: the encoding of the most recent observation is held until the next game update updates it
policy.targets: mapped non-motor sensory populations only; the mapping excludes the motor and LEFT/RIGHT/JUMP masks

limitations: The feature-to-BANC population assignment is a labelled hypothesis or convention (Phase 4H.4), not a measured sensory pathway.
Distances are normalised game-world units, not metric distances.
The decoder labels LEFT/RIGHT/JUMP are decoder labels, not identified biological motor commands; UNMAPPED and DUCK execute NO_ACTION.
Rewards are the synthetic task rewards defined by the game rules; they are not a biological dopamine, octopamine or serotonin measurement.
This is a fixed-weight control demonstration: no learning or plasticity is performed and Phase 8 owns training.

definitions.LEFT: super_class == 'motor' and side == 'left' and body_part_effector in ['front_leg', 'middle_leg', 'hind_leg'] and not a tergotrochanter candidate
definitions.RIGHT: super_class == 'motor' and side == 'right' and body_part_effector in ['front_leg', 'middle_leg', 'hind_leg'] and not a tergotrochanter candidate
definitions.UNASSIGNED: motor neurons not covered by LEFT, RIGHT or JUMP
definitions.ROLL: unsupported: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a roll motor population; a roll signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.
definitions.DUCK: unsupported: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a duck or crouch motor population; a duck signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.

provenance.overlap_policy: tergotrochanter candidates are also leg motor neurons; by default they are removed from LEFT/RIGHT so the action populations are disjoint and JUMP activity is not double-counted

unsupported_actions.DUCK: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a duck or crouch motor population; a duck signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.

provenance.scientific_status: LEFT, RIGHT and JUMP are decoder labels derived from published effector annotations. They are not identified biological motor commands.

observation_adapter.selection: nearest visible object of each kind; remaining objects are reported as unrepresented

player_state_mapping.COLLIDED: neither jumping nor rolling; warning recorded

observation_adapter.future_objects: the game observation only contains spawned, currently visible objects; no future obstacle position is available or inferred

unsupported_states.UNMAPPED: the Phase 4 decoder reported UNMAPPED; NO_ACTION is executed rather than an arbitrary game action
unsupported_states.DUCK: the controlled game has no duck action; DUCK is executed as NO_ACTION

action_adapter.note: the requested motor state and the executed game action are recorded separately; no unsupported state becomes a different action

reward.classification: synthetic task reward derived from controlled-game events; not a biological dopamine, octopamine or serotonin measurement

rendering.note: render() draws the current frame; the simulation advances on the fixed game timestep and never depends on frame rate
